Employee Handbook
Paid Time Off
Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual leave each calendar year. Sick leave should be reported to the direct manager before 10:00 a.m. on the day of absence. Unused annual leave may be carried forward for up to five days with manager approval.

Employee Handbook
Travel and Expenses
Airfare and hotel expenses must be approved before booking. Meal reimbursements require itemized receipts. Ground transportation is reimbursable when the trip is business related and documented in the expense report.

Employee Handbook
Security and Access
Employees must use multi-factor authentication on all corporate systems. After five failed login attempts, the account is locked for 30 minutes. Visitors must be escorted at all times in badge-controlled areas.
